exact_statement: Let h be a balanced uniform Boolean core with a supplied actual certificate H(h)<=4I(h), F_h=(-1)^a on x=0, h on x=b=1, and +1 otherwise. Let M be the completed matched-marginal canonical nonempty occupancy reference of F_h, A=KL(P||M)=(15/16)K_occ. Query b first, then any finite adaptive fresh data-only continuation in b1, retaining b0 and keeping x,a unqueried. Assume every terminal core g has a supplied actual H(g)<=4I(g) certificate. Use one unchanged original M, its actual coherent kernels and fair source-zero fallback, retaining all reference-only rows and full terminal entropy. Write S=E(4Ileaf-Hleaf), Sroot=4Iroot-Hroot, R=Iroot-EIleaf, D=Hroot-EHleaf, L=A+[D-4R]_+, and G=h2(1/4)+sum_j h2(Inf_j(h)/4). Then S-L=min(S-A,Sroot-A)>=2-A>=3+H(h)/4-G. Hence G<3+H(h)/4 is sufficient for complete same-owner payment. In particular, for h_m=chi_z*(1-2*1[y_1=...=y_m=0]), every integer m>=3 and every such finite adaptive data history have G(h_m)<85/32 and S-L>11/32+H(h_m)/4. All required core certificates hold under arbitrary data restrictions; h_m is genuinely non-flat and balanced. An already booked conservative overpayment 0<=omega<=11/32 is additionally paid as L+omega from the same S, with strictly positive remainder. At m=3 G>2, so the old sufficient marginal threshold G<2 fails while the exact source is admitted. No arbitrary-core root/terminal certificate, mixed control policy, fresh reset or universal FEI theorem is asserted.
hypotheses: Finite uniform independent sign inputs, entropy and KL in bits; the actual root F_h and original completed canonical occupancy reference are fixed.
Balanced core h, supplied actual root H(h)<=4I(h) and supplied actual terminal core certificates; these are proved for the stated h_m family, not assumed universally.
Query b then fresh data only in b1, retaining b0 and keeping x,a unqueried; any finite adaptive stopping policy with all complete terminal laws.
Same original normalized reference is transported by the actual coherent channel, fair on every source-zero row; reference-only mass is retained. No descendant reference renewal.
S is the same genuinely available final surplus owner; prior conservative booking omega is explicitly added once. Unpaid earlier ancestor work and fresh-reference resets are outside scope.
All-dimensional instantiation m>=3 has one independent character and an m-bit point defect; all actual data restrictions remain in the certified family.
